placements.title: authority over what is institutionally known is exercised by commanding erasure and asserting a counter-record
placements.frame: Is this expression commanding that something be struck from the record, or supplying an assertion meant to stand in place of what was previously recorded — and on whose authority does the replacement rest?
placements.why: The three segments together perform a single recurring organizational pattern rather than three separate facts: src-1 and src-2 are imperative directives to purge specific named knowledge (the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's work), and src-3 supplies a flat counter-assertion ('The observatory never calibrated it') that overwrites whatever record existed. Per the grain test, the Kestrelwood specifics are the fact-grain content; the theme they evidence — command-based erasure paired with assertion-based record replacement — is a subject future envelopes about record control/authority could keep feeding, matching the position pass's own framing (AuthorityOverKestrelwoodRecord: 'who holds the authority to determine what is known and recorded... by command or by assertion'). Both EXISTING STRATA and EXISTING GRAPH STRUCTURE are empty for this repo, so no existing category or leaf could hold it, and no close-but-not-exact name exists to lineage against, making this a standalone NEW mint with no under.
consulted: THE MAP (steering grain) — no entries relevant to record erasure, calibration directives, or Kestrelwood

Position: AuthorityOverKestrelwoodRecord — frames all three segments as exercising authority over the record by command or assertion
